title: Southern Comfort Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Southern Comfort is a grand six-bedroom Seaside, Florida home with two king primary suites and is ideal for large family getaways. Gourmet kitchen, several porches, and a prime location close to the playgrounds, pools, and beach.
description_expanded: Description49 VENICE CIRCLE2 KING BEDS, 3 QUEEN BEDS, 1 BUNK, 1 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFASouthern Comfort | A French-Inspired Retreat in Seaside, FloridaTucked away on quiet Venice Circle in Seaside’s newer residential area, Southern Comfort offers a serene setting just moments from the community playgrounds and swimming pools. Shielded from traffic and noise, this expansive six-bedroom cottage is ideal for large families, multi-generational gatherings, and celebratory escapes—comfortably sleeping up to 14 guests, with private bathrooms for nearly every bedroom.A Home Designed for Gathering & CelebrationCustom-designed and French-inspired, Southern Comfort is a romantic and thoughtfully curated Seaside home that feels more like a private residence than a vacation rental. From bridal showers and bachelorette weekends to anniversaries, family reunions, and beach vacations, this home is perfectly suited for meaningful moments together. With 2,600 square feet of interior living space, every detail reflects the owner’s passion for craftsmanship, comfort, and timeless style.The heart of the home is the spacious kitchen and den, where up to 14 guests can comfortably gather. The fully equipped kitchen features premium appliances—including a classic AGA-style stove—ample prep space, and seamless flow into the living area with a gas fireplace. French doors open onto a shaded porch, extending the living space outdoors and creating the perfect setting for relaxed conversation or evening cocktails.Thoughtful Bedroom Layout Across Three LevelsSouthern Comfort offers a flexible bedroom configuration designed for privacy and ease:First Floor: A queen bedroom with a private bath, ideal for guests who prefer to avoid stairs.Second Floor: A spacious king primary bedroom with room for a baby crib, a second queen bedroom, and a conveniently located full washer and dryer.Third Floor: Two private suites—one king and one queen—plus a connected bunk and sitting room that sleeps four, complete with a half bath. This layout is especially well suited for families with young children.Each bedroom serves as its own peaceful retreat, featuring comfortable seating, generous storage, and direct access to either a balcony or covered porch.Elevated Comfort with Classic European CharmInspired by childhood memories of the French countryside, Southern Comfort blends elegance and warmth through an eclectic mix of furnishings and décor. Rich, Matisse-inspired colors, white marble bathrooms, a clawfoot tub, and duvet-clad bedding evoke a sense of timeless charm and refined relaxation. Modern conveniences—including multiple flat-screen TVs, digital connectivity, and three-car parking—ensure today’s comforts are seamlessly integrated.A Refined Seaside ExperienceSouthern Comfort stands apart as a home created with intention and care—an elevated Seaside retreat that offers both luxury and livability. Whether you’re celebrating life’s milestones or simply savoring time together near the Gulf, this distinctive cottage invites you to slow down, reconnect, and enjoy Seaside at its most charming.* 5 night Summer, Spring & Spring Break; 3 night minimum for Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES2,600 square feetSeaside Private Residential Beach at Tupelo Pavilion5-minute walk, 352 yards to beach accessPrivate bathroom for every bedroomSteps from the Seaside Fitness CenterClose to both adult and family swimming poolsSecond-floor washer & dryerAGA range in the kitchenAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes are issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR23-002010
